path.single_route.claim: Every PICK_UP/PREPARE_FOR_DROP_OFF/DROP_OFF/FINISH_DROP_OFF response of a mobile runs inside a guide arrival verdict (gd_updt.c -> navigation_guide_waypoint_reached -> response_to_waypoint_reached), exactly once per verdict, sent to that verdict's task leader for that waypoint

criteria.leader_only.claim: At the four SUPPLY types the guide's criteria are: last-to-reach off (task leader only), no waypoint action, reached radius 100 m (fixed-wing leader) or 40 m (helicopter leader)

members.leader_only_consumed.claim: At the four SUPPLY types every arrival check asks the task leader, and only the task leader, for its per-member reach test; each verdict follows the leader's own answer, whatever the other members' state

leader.state_at_verdict.claim: At each verdict the task leader is in the guide's group, not landed, and within the radius (helicopter: rotors spun up and range <= radius; fixed wing: range - speed <= radius, the pass-through early out)

order.guide_advances_first.claim: When the leader's response runs, its guide already has the next waypoint

pickup.accounting.claim: PICK_UP: with a crate at the supplier, exactly one crate (of the task's cargo type when the supplier has one, S3; else the first) moves from the supplier onto the task leader and the supplier's level of that type drops by 10; with none, nothing changes

dropoff.accounting.claim: DROP_OFF: only the task leader's load is read; a keysite requester receives the first identified crate aboard and its level of that type is set to 100 (any further crates stay aboard); a group requester's level rises and the crate stays aboard; with nothing aboard nothing changes

finish.completes_success.claim: FINISH_DROP_OFF: inside its span the task receives TASK_COMPLETED (objective message) and is set to SUCCESS (when still incomplete)

identity.generations.claim: No event names an entity [index, generation] after that generation was freed

trace.complete.claim: The trace's exit counters agree with its events, and no response ran outside a span

correlation.public_path.claim: Every keysite level change inside a PICK_UP or DROP_OFF span appears in the public path's observations at the next 1 s sample, in the same direction, with the task leader tracked there in the same group

supply_success_without_delivery.label: outside any arrival span, TASK_TERMINATED_OBJECTIVE_MESSAGE, no DROP_OFF arrival, requester group freed in the same frame
